messages:
Fix free shipping at 50.00 € and count quantities

Orders whose items come to exactly 50.00 € were charged shipping,
because the threshold was compared with `>` instead of `>=`. Shipping
also summed unit prices without multiplying by quantity, so three
bottles at 17.00 € (51.00 € of items) were charged shipping.

Shipping now counts quantities and ships free from 50.00 € of items,
as the rule states. Tests cover the exact threshold, quantities, and
the just-under case, which still pays shipping.

Pending approval by Dana Okafor (approver); not released.
